application_review: PROGRESS. Previous round rechecked and retained proof hashes preserved.
The arbitrary-vertex correlation bound replaces only the anchor function and uses the verified independence of the punctured dual from that anchor. The test function has no unit-bound hypothesis.
The existing audited dyadic weighted power inequality is reused rather than duplicated. It keeps nonnegative normalized cell probabilities and justifies comparison with the weighted Gowers root.
The weighted mixed dual bound preserves the original cell coefficients and uses the same finite subgroup in all cells.
Zero-root orthogonality is proved in both directions for unit-bounded tests; the reverse direction tests against the dual of the test itself and uses the exact root-power identity.

Five theorems are individually audited. These finite statements do not construct Loeb characteristic factors, prove their localization or supply concatenation/Bessel. The main target remains unproved.
remaining: The common-system master estimates, first-order Bessel, dual energy reduction, recursion and stability are proved. Actual dual functions now have a common finite empirical approximation preserving arbitrary cell probabilities, unit bounds and uniform bounded-test correlations. Exact arbitrary-vertex reflection of the actual subgroup cube law and mixed products is now proved. Mixed cubes now have exact arbitrary-vertex duality and weighted single-vertex replacement estimates. Finite products of dual functions now have quantitative empirical approximation uniform over bounded tests. Exact translated-product expansions and extraction for each fixed test are now proved. The exact mixed face split, projected-face correlation and one-step face Cauchy-Schwarz inequality are now proved. Face energies are now identified with actual copied cube means, with nonnegativity and copy algebra verified. Arbitrary-coordinate permutation invariance, copied-mean nonnegativity and reflection bounds are now established. Full multidimensional mixed Gowers Cauchy-Schwarz, the product-root bound and the single-vertex bound are now proved. Actual dual anti-uniformity, its weighted version and the finite zero-root orthogonality characterization are now proved. Higher-order concatenation controlling dual correlations and the full qualitative Bessel theorem remain missing, as do remaining replica integration, cyclic-to-interval transfer and inverse correlator existence. Coloring-derived targets, Calibration/Alignment and final ordered positive rapidly separated monochromatic extraction remain. StrongConjecture is unchanged and unproved. No unavoidable blocker is established; publication, PR and prize application remain pending.
